R01 Insufficient Funds
Synthetic Alpha policy: an R01 insufficient-funds payment may be retried three times. Review within four working days.
documents.beta.txt:
R01 Insufficient Funds
Synthetic Beta policy: an R01 insufficient-funds payment may be retried three times. Review within eleven working days.
documents.closed.txt:
R02 Account Closed
The customer's bank account is permanently closed. Do not retry. Obtain replacement bank account details from the customer.
documents.consumer.txt:
R10 Consumer Not Authorized
A consumer reports they never authorized the debit. Resolve authorization with the customer before any new debit.
documents.corporate.txt:
R29 Corporate Not Authorized
A corporate business account holder says the debit was not authorized. Investigate the authorization before another payment.
documents.invalid.txt:
R03 Unable to Locate Account
The supplied account number does not identify a bank account. Ask for corrected bank details.
